name: Ben Tre
provinceNote: Nghị quyết 202/2025/QH15, clause 20: Bến Tre, Trà Vinh, and Vĩnh Long become the new Vĩnh Long province, 6,296.20 km² and 4,257,581 people, beside Đồng Tháp, Cần Thơ, and the sea.
dotReason: Worth a night when the coconut bank of the Tiền is the trip
summary: A Mekong Delta town in coconut country on the Tien River, about two hours from Ho Chi Minh City. Take a boat into the palm-lined creeks, visit the islets of Con Phung and Con Quy, and try coconut candy and fresh coconut. A day and a night suits anyone who wants the quieter side of the delta.
fee: Check on arrival. Cồn Phụng has no listed tariff. Bảo tàng Bến Tre at 146 Hùng Vương: 07:00–17:00 every day, or 07:30–11:00 and 13:30–17:00. The Friday and Saturday town cart is free. Đồng Khởi, the Ba Tri memorial, the Long ferry, a bicycle, and the water park: Check on arrival.
getThere: 86 km and 1.5 hours, about two hours, about 85 km and about 2 hours, or 85–90 km and 1.5–2 hours from Ho Chi Minh City. No passenger train. Coach, taxi, motorbike, bicycle, and boat fares: Check on arrival. Minutes from Tân Sơn Nhất, from the Mỹ Tho pier, and on to the relic: Check on arrival. Cồn Phụng is 12 km by road and 25 km by river, or about 10 km.
seoTitle: Ben Tre travel guide — coconut canals, sampans, and the islets
seoDescription: A sampan in the nipa creeks, coconut palms on the south bank of the Tiền, and the islets of Cồn Phụng and Cồn Quy. Coconut candy is warm at the kiln.
intro: You sit low in a sampan in a nipa creek on the south bank of the Tiền, coconut palms over the water and the town behind you. Bảo is one of three strips, with Minh and An Hóa, cut by the Tiền, Hàm Luông, Ba Lai, and Cổ Chiên. Stay the night if that coconut bank is the trip. Sleep in Mỹ Tho if you wanted the north-bank embankment. The boat has to be the morning on a same-day return.

Cồn Phụng is the orchard gate on this bank, not cù lao Thới Sơn. It sits in xã Tân Thạch, huyện Châu Thành, 12 km by road and 25 km by river from the city center, and also about 10 km, at ấp 10 (Ấp Tân Vinh), xã Phú Túc, tỉnh Vĩnh Long. Clause 59 of Nghị quyết 1687/NQ-UBTVQH15 merges thị trấn Châu Thành and the communes Tân Thạch, Tường Đa, and Phú Túc into xã Phú Túc. Ask for either name. The clause does not say the islet moved. The four nicknames are Long, Lân, Quy, and Phụng. Cù lao Long is on this side, by a short ferry past the Ben Tre Market and the Ben Tre River. Lân is not assigned a bank. Quy is a longan orchard. The Friday town cart is not the way onto the islet.

The morning starts on đường 30 Tháng 4, then walks to Bảo tàng Bến Tre at 146 Hùng Vương, given as phường An Hội and as Phường 3. Phường 4 and Phường 5 merged into An Hội from 1 December 2024, and clause 116 of Nghị quyết 1687 forms a new phường An Hội without naming Hùng Vương, so the number stays 146 Hùng Vương. After dinner the walk is Hồ Trúc Giang, công viên Bến Tre, công viên Trần Văn Ơn, and công viên Đồng Khởi, then chợ đêm Bến Tre and khu phố chợ Phú Khương. Công viên Đồng Khởi in town is not the Đồng Khởi relic at Định Thủy.
gettingAround: No airport sits in the Ben Tre wards. The road from Ho Chi Minh City is the approach, and Tân Sơn Nhất is the airport at that end. There is no passenger train. Tourist boats start once you are already on the river. Local buses connect the delta provinces with Bến xe Miền Tây, and Thảo Châu is one company to Ben Tre. Quốc lộ 60 and Quốc lộ 57 continue toward the old Vĩnh Long and Trà Vinh.

From Mỹ Tho, Quốc lộ 60 crosses the Tiền on Cầu Rạch Miễu and on Cầu Rạch Miễu 2. Cầu Rạch Miễu 2 was ready to open from 19 August 2025, after a check on 12 August: more than 17.6 km in all, main bridge more than 1,971 m, investment more than 6,810 billion VND, from ngã tư Đồng Tâm in Đồng Tháp to Quốc lộ 60 in Vĩnh Long. The length is also about 17.6 km, the end near Km16+660, about 0.71 km from the north abutment of Cầu Hàm Luông, old TP. Bến Tre, now phường Bến Tre, and the start now xã Hưng Long, Đồng Tháp. The opening was about 11:30 on 19 August 2025, and the older bridge about 4 km downstream stayed open that day. The temporary ferry stopped on 20 August 2025. The two “about 10 km” lines describe that ferry, not the drive from Mỹ Tho.

In town the walk is Hồ Trúc Giang and the three parks, then the night market and khu phố chợ Phú Khương. The near-city orchard boats leave bến tàu du lịch thành phố Bến Tre. Cồn Phụng is a different landing: 12 km by road and 25 km by river, or about 10 km. On Fridays and Saturdays a free seven-seat cart picks up at Sense City at 17:30 and 19:30 and at 708 Nguyễn Văn Tư at 19:00 and 21:00. Cycling is the way through the groves, and most hotels lend bicycles. Use a taxi meter, and bargain a xe ôm. The tourism office at 108/1 đường 30/4 is an office, not a station. Phường 4 on that line is a pre-December 2024 name.

The Đồng Khởi relic is a second morning, not the boat. Cross Cầu Hàm Luông on Quốc lộ 57, more than 10 km to thị trấn Mỏ Cày Nam, then left about 4 km. The city distance is also about 15 km. Do not add those into one distance. Cầu Hàm Luông is the river south of town. It is not Cầu Rạch Miễu.

stayAreas.summary: A river room on the town bank, so the evening is Hồ Trúc Giang, the parks, and the night market.

stayAreas.name: A garden on a near islet
stayAreas.summary: A garden homestay where the town boats go, under the old names Mỹ Thạnh An and Phú Nhuận, or a house on Cồn Phụng if the night is the orchard rather than the lake. No brand.

eat: Breakfast on đường 30 Tháng 4 is hủ tiếu with a pork-pâté slice. The dinner bowl of the same noodle is pork, shrimp, a quail egg, lime, and cilantro. The street is the area.

Lunch on the boat is the garden table: đuông dừa fried in butter, cá tai tượng chiên xù, xôi chiên phồng, lẩu mắm, cơm trái dừa, and tép rang dừa. On 4 June 2021 the salad is gỏi củ hủ dừa tôm thịt, with creamy coconut rice and coconut-braised shrimp. The 4 November 2021 list adds nấm mối xào nước cốt dừa, ốc len xào dừa, and bánh xèo ốc gạo. The town-boat lunch adds dê hấp tía tô, lẩu gà lá giang, and ốc bươu nướng tiêu xanh. Kẹo dừa is warm at the kiln or wrapped to take home. The plain piece is coconut milk and sugar, and also coconut milk, maltose, and yellow cane sugar. More than 300 factories, and more than 180 workshops. Honey tea, a young coconut, and dừa nước are the drinks.

Bánh tráng Mỹ Lồng is rice paper from sticky rice and coconut milk, with sugar, salt, sesame, and sometimes milk or egg. One origin is about 100 years, from the elders, and another ties the dry rations to the Nguyễn–Trịnh years. Bánh phồng Sơn Đốc is glutinous rice pounded with coconut milk and sugar, then grilled so the cracker puffs to 3–4 times its size. The craft is more than 100 years old and began as a Tết offering, with 51 households, about 25 million crackers a year, and a cooperative of 20 members. Both were listed as national intangible heritage by Quyết định số 4069/QĐ-BVHTTDL on 30 October 2018. Grill the paper or the cracker, or carry them home. The yards run all year and longer near Tết.
interestsBody: Give the morning to a boat on the Tiền. Cồn Phụng is the orchard gate. Cù lao Long is the short ferry past the market. Cồn Quy is longan. Lân has no bank named. The four nicknames are not one island, and Cồn Phụng is not cù lao Thới Sơn.

The palms are the crop: 53,000 ha, more than 60,000 ha, above 62,000 ha, and over 200,000 ha. About 500 million nuts a year. About a quarter of the country’s coconut land, and also nearly half. After dinner the walk is Hồ Trúc Giang and the market street.

Keep Đồng Khởi at Định Thủy, and the memorial of Nguyễn Đình Chiểu at Ba Tri, for another morning. The sea districts are a wild shore: nearly 20 km of beach at Ba Tri, and 65 km for the old province. Those are not the same measurement. Chợ Lách is fruit and ornamental gardens.

interestGroups.title: Dining and F&B
interestGroups.summary: The kiln and the garden lunch.
body: Kẹo dừa is warm at the kiln or wrapped to take home. The plain piece is coconut milk and sugar, and also coconut milk, maltose, and yellow cane sugar. More than 300 factories, and more than 180 workshops, and tens of thousands of tons a year. Later pieces take durian, peanut, cacao, or pandan. The boil is at Cồn Phụng. Xôi chiên phồng is on the same lunch list, with đuông dừa fried in butter, cá tai tượng chiên xù, lẩu mắm, cơm trái dừa, and tép rang dừa. Also nấm mối xào nước cốt dừa, ốc len xào dừa, and bánh xèo ốc gạo.

Breakfast on đường 30 Tháng 4 is hủ tiếu with a pork-pâté slice. The dinner bowl of the same noodle is pork, shrimp, a quail egg, lime, and cilantro. Honey tea is the sit-down drink, and on the town boat the guest mixes trà mật ong phấn hoa.

interestGroups.title: The Tiền and the islets
interestGroups.summary: For a boat on this bank of the river, not a canal morning in Cần Thơ.
body: Cồn Phụng is the longer version of the river day. On the ground of Đạo Dừa you walk Tòa Bảo tháp, Sân Rồng with nine dragons for the nine Mekong mouths, and Cửu Trùng đài. The stop adds coconut candy, rice paper, more than 500 shell-craft objects, honey tea, đờn ca tài tử, a horse cart under the palms, and a sampan in a nipa creek. The town boat is the shorter version: a nipa creek, a kiln, fruit in season, a sampan, and lunch under the palms, from bến tàu du lịch thành phố Bến Tre. That pier is not the Cồn Phụng wharf.

Cồn Quy is longan, honey tea, and a ditch you can bail for fish and cook. Do not reuse the Cồn Phụng distances. Cù lao Long is a morning bicycle past the Ben Tre Market and the Ben Tre River, then a short ferry. Lân has no bank named. Other islets on the Hàm Luông stay unnamed.

interestGroups.title: Xứ dừa
interestGroups.summary: For the palms, the kiln, and the two craft villages inland.
body: This is the coconut country of Vietnam: more than 60,000 ha and about 500 million nuts a year, also 53,000 ha and about a quarter of the country’s coconut land, also above 62,000 ha by the 2015 festival, and also over 200,000 ha, nearly half of the country’s coconut land. Candy, milk, oil, and shell craft are the products. The plain candy is coconut milk and sugar, and also coconut milk, maltose, and yellow cane sugar. Eat it warm at the kiln. More than 500 coconut-shell objects are made here.

Mỹ Lồng, old xã Mỹ Thạnh, huyện Giồng Trôm, is the rice-paper yard. Clause 92 merges Mỹ Thạnh, Thuận Điền, and Lương Phú into xã Lương Phú and does not erase the craft name. Sơn Đốc sits in xã Hưng Nhượng, with the work in the hamlets and ấp Hưng Bình named for the households. Clause 88 keeps the name Hưng Nhượng. The two yards are not the same visit. Both were listed as national intangible heritage by Quyết định số 4069/QĐ-BVHTTDL on 30 October 2018.

cards.title: Coconut country
cards.summary: A bicycle under coconut palms. 53,000 ha, more than 60,000 ha, above 62,000 ha, and over 200,000 ha.

interestGroups.title: Nguyễn Đình Chiểu
interestGroups.summary: For the poet’s tomb at Ba Tri, on 1 July or on an ordinary day.
body: The tomb and memorial sit at old xã An Đức, 2 km from the center of thị trấn Ba Tri, on tỉnh lộ 885 through Giồng Trôm. Clause 83 merges thị trấn Ba Tri and the communes Vĩnh Hòa, An Đức, Vĩnh An, and An Bình Tây into xã Ba Tri and does not say the tomb moved. It was listed a national historic relic on 27 April 1990, on 13,000 m². The birth date is 1 July 1822. He was not born in Bến Tre. He lived and worked here.

The culture program runs 30 June–2 July, and the day itself is 1 July on the solar calendar. On an ordinary day the ground is still the visit. The program includes đờn ca tài tử, a costume play of Lục Vân Tiên and Kiều Nguyệt Nga, recited verse, drum, traditional martial arts, a feast, and yard games.

cards.title: The Ba Tri memorial
cards.summary: A national historic relic since 27 April 1990. The culture day is 1 July solar.

interestGroups.title: A family on the water
interestGroups.summary: For the boat, the sampan, and the kiln, with the water park only after that.
body: The family day is the boat, the sampan in a nipa creek, and the candy kiln. A horse cart runs under the palms on Cồn Quy. After dark a motorboat runs along bần and nipa, with young coconut and fruit on board and fireflies in the creeks.

TTC Mekong Aqua Park, at 547D Nguyễn Đình Chiểu, ấp Phú Chiến, xã Phú Hưng, is the afternoon extra, with Tiny Zoo and a lunch court beside it. Clause 117 does not name Nguyễn Đình Chiểu. The address stays. It is a hot afternoon after the boat, not the reason to come.

cards.title: A horse cart on Cồn Quy
cards.summary: The family day on the water: sampan, kiln, and a horse cart. The water park is the afternoon extra.

interestGroups.title: Đồng Khởi
interestGroups.summary: For the 17 January 1960 ground, on a morning that is not the boat.
body: The rising opened on the morning of 17 January 1960 at Đình Rắn and the Vàm Nước post, in old xã Định Thủy, huyện Mỏ Cày Nam. Clause 70 merges Định Thủy, Phước Hiệp, and Bình Khánh into xã Đồng Khởi and does not say the house moved. Nhà truyền thống opened on 17 January 2000, nearly 5,000 m², on the old province-chief compound. The torch is 12 m high and 4.5 m across, with three wings. Đình Rắn, also called đình Định Nhơn, is 500 m northeast, rebuilt in 2005, 11 m by 25 m. The eight gold characters on the stone, from Hồ Chí Minh, read “Anh dũng Đồng Khởi, thắng Mỹ diệt ngụy”.

The anniversary gatherings use 17 January. The road is across Cầu Hàm Luông on Quốc lộ 57, more than 10 km to thị trấn Mỏ Cày Nam, then left about 4 km, or about 15 km from the city. Do not add those into one distance. Công viên Đồng Khởi in town is not this house. Bảo tàng Bến Tre is 146 Hùng Vương, open 07:00–17:00 every day, or 07:30–11:00 and 13:30–17:00.

interestGroups.title: Shopping
interestGroups.summary: Chợ Bến Tre on the way to the river, the night street after the lake, and candy from the kiln.
body: Chợ Bến Tre is on the cycle past the market and the Ben Tre River, before the short ferry to Cù lao Long. The day-market front is not the night market.

After dinner the walk is Hồ Trúc Giang, công viên Bến Tre, công viên Trần Văn Ơn, and công viên Đồng Khởi, then chợ đêm Bến Tre and khu phố chợ Phú Khương. The night stalls are on Đại lộ Đồng Khởi. Clause 117 merges the old phường Phú Khương into a new phường Phú Khương with Phường 8, Phú Hưng, and Nhơn Thạnh. The night street is still khu phố chợ Phú Khương. Kẹo dừa, warm at the kiln or wrapped, is the other thing to carry. More than 300 factories, and more than 180 workshops.

blocks.heading: Chợ Bến Tre
paragraphs: The day hall sits on the way toward the river and the short ferry to Cù lao Long. After dinner, chợ đêm Bến Tre and khu phố chợ Phú Khương follow the lake walk. The night stalls are on Đại lộ Đồng Khởi.

Coconut candy is warm at the kiln on Cồn Phụng, or wrapped to take home. Bánh tráng Mỹ Lồng and bánh phồng Sơn Đốc are the inland craft sweets, listed as national intangible heritage on 30 October 2018.

faqs.q: How far is Ben Tre from Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: 86 km and 1.5 hours by car on the Ho Chi Minh City–Trung Lương expressway, about two hours, about 85 km and about 2 hours, or 85–90 km and 1.5–2 hours. No passenger train.

faqs.q: How far is Cồn Phụng, and what is the gate?
faqs.a: 12 km by road and 25 km by river from the city center, and also about 10 km. No tariff is listed. The town orchard pier is a different landing.

faqs.q: Which province is this, and how big is it?
faqs.a: Clause 20 of Nghị quyết 202/2025/QH15 joins Bến Tre, Trà Vinh, and Vĩnh Long into the new Vĩnh Long province, 6,296.20 km² and 4,257,581 people, beside Đồng Tháp, Cần Thơ, and the sea. The old province is still given as 2,379.7 km² and 1,299,328 people, with Tiền Giang to the north, Trà Vinh to the south, Vĩnh Long to the west, and the sea to the east, and, on 4 November 2021, as 2,394.82 km² and about 1.3 million people. Article 2 tells the Government to fix the boundary. The clause does not name a capital.

The coconut festival is held every two years around 30 April. The editions named are 2009, 2010, 2012, 2015, and a fifth then planned for November 2019. Those lists do not match. The culture day at the poet’s memorial is 1 July, with a program from 30 June to 2 July. Đồng Khởi gatherings use 17 January. Nghinh Ông is the 15th and 16th of the sixth lunar month, and the fruit fair is Tết Đoan Ngọ on the 5th of the fifth lunar month. The solar days move.

season.label: Mild year-round
season.note: The weather is mild year-round. For the dry season 2024–2025, salinity could reach the rivers from the second half of December 2024 and peak about February and March 2025. Rain flooded nearly 0.5 m deep on Quốc lộ 57B near Khu công nghiệp Giao Long on 6 October 2024. That is not a closure of the Rạch Miễu crossing. The coconut festival is every two years around 30 April, with editions in 2009, 2010, 2012, 2015, and a fifth then planned for November 2019. The culture day is 1 July. Đồng Khởi uses 17 January.
